MACD 히스토그램은 289.8999로 개선세 지속. 4시간봉 RSI 74.1로 과매수 진입, MACD 히스토그램 105.9030으로 개선. 주봉 ADX 26.6으로 뚜렷한 추세 유지. 현재가 $84,920.66은 스윙 저항선 $86,429.35에 근접. ATR 대비 손절폭 1.3배($3,000), 목표 2.6배($6,000) 설정 시 손익비 1.5 이상 확보 가능. 그러나 과매수 구간 진입 및 저항선 근접으로 인한 단기 되돌림 가능성 고려하여 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 71.4 entering overbought territory, closing with 5 consecutive bullish candles and updating the 5-day high. MACD histogram continues to improve at 289.8999. 4-hour RSI at 74.1 entering overbought, MACD histogram improving at 105.9030. Weekly ADX at 26.6 maintains a clear trend. Current price $84,920.66 approaches the swing resistance at $86,429.35. A stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($3,000) and target of 2.6x ATR ($6,000) would yield a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher. However, due to entering overbought conditions and proximity to resistance, a short-term pullback is possible, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
